lines.1: She fired a mass of table-tennis balls at once.
lines.2: There was no way to tell which one was the real ball.
lines.3: A truly dazzling strike. Her ultimate technique.
lines.5: Yashi silently looked at the referee.
lines.6: 「Sigh... Game, set, and match. Yashi wins. Crab, you're useless.」
lines.7: ...Crab played her own improvised brand of combat table tennis.
lines.8: We might allow it among ourselves, but naturally the real world did not.
lines.9: 「Crabby loses by foul. You obviously can't hit a whole bunch of balls at once.」
lines.11: 「Watching you self-destruct isn't satisfying at all.」
lines.12: 「You have real potential. If you'd just played normally, it could've gone either way...」
lines.13: There was no other word for her but idiot.
lines.14: 「Nagomin, you've played a little table tennis before. What about you, Crabby?」
lines.15: 「I'm self-taught. I just play with friends at community centers and stuff.」
lines.16: 「I-It's amazing you can play that well without training.」
lines.21: 「It seems that was not much of a friendly match.」
lines.22: 「If anything, I think the rift between them just got deeper.」
lines.23: All it did was leave everyone exhausted...
